important_boundaries: Same-size window/door replacement is listed as permit-exempt; new/enlarged/relocated openings require a building permit.
Structural alterations including adding/removing walls require a permit.
Plumbing alterations/additions/extensions require a permit, except replacing existing fixtures.
Attached/adjacent deck over 600 mm above grade requires a permit regardless of area; elevated principal-access deck requires a permit.

Qualifying low-rise residential sheds/gazebos/pergolas/similar structures up to 15 m2 can use the 2025 A-001 exemption if independent, <=1 storey, no plumbing, no heating, and personal ancillary use only.
Designated heritage / Heritage District Overlay properties are not subject to normal permit exemptions and require City review.
Applications deemed complete on/after 2026-03-11 require dual zoning review under 2008-250 and 2026-50 with the most restrictive provisions applying; some 2026-50 provisions remain under appeal.
